snippet.title: Harry Drinks Liquid Luck | Half-Blood Prince
snippet.description:
Feeling lucky? Harry certainly was when he drank Felix Felicis (also known as Liquid Luck) in order to help him in his task of getting vital information from Professor Slughorn. Relive this iconic scene with us and who knows, maybe some luck will rub off on you!

The Harry Potter: Complete 8-Film Collection is available on Blu-ray and Digital now.
